text:
Plant Club lets you list **up to 3 plants you already own** so they aren't sent as duplicates. That's the only way to avoid them, since you can't choose the plant itself. The Collector plan is also a surprise plant, so it works the same way.

Our policy doesn't say whether your existing list carries over when you change plans, so I can't promise it will. After you upgrade, check that your list of owned plants is still there under **Account > Subscriptions**, and re-add any that are missing. If the list doesn't show up or you can't edit it, I can escalate it to a Support Lead.

Because the list is capped at 3, a plant you own that isn't on it could still be sent. Collector boxes also include medium or rare plants, which you may not have yet.

Is there anything else I can help with?
